rows.label: Where your data lives
rows.managedHtml: With you — your cluster, your control plane, your databases
rows.turnkeyHtml: With us, in our Hetzner account

rows.label: What we have visibility into
rows.managedHtml: Only metadata — architectural guarantee from cluster ownership
rows.turnkeyHtml: Metadata by design (Minimal Data Exposure architecture), but the account is ours — so the guarantee is policy-level rather than structural

rows.label: Exit when you stop paying
rows.managedHtml: Your cluster keeps running. OSS takes over management. UI/Backstage you can self-host (we ship the tooling). You only lose the thin cloud-native premium layer — AI insights, cross-cluster aggregator, smart bill analysis.
rows.turnkeyHtml: Cross-cluster MigrationPlan tooling (Phase 8+) for orchestrated migration.

footnoteHtml: <sup>†</sup> FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 allows any use — personal, internal business, commercial workloads — except offering AppRafter itself as a managed service to third parties. After two years, the license auto-converts to plain Apache 2.0 and that restriction lifts.
